name: wake-no-replug
summary: After a deep-standby wake, the DP port is re-enabled without its HPD-low step (no emulated unplug: the PC does not re-detect the monitor, other monitors do not blank); other ports as stock
status: v3 untested (v2 hardware-tested 2026-10-07: deep-standby wakes over DP without disconnect; one slow wake of ~20 s seen later, cause unknown)

edits.asm: sub_239479 entry (addi r1,-0xc + first byte of sw 8(r1),r9) -> j wnr (0x23947D unused)

notes: Deep-standby wake (PM 0x3AA bits 4:2 == 1) within the first 5 s: the HPD-low command (8, 0, 0) of the DP port (mailbox 0x20 sub 14, sub_239479) is not sent; (8, 1, 650), the other ports' commands, the port configuration and enable (0x60 sub 2, 0x20 sub 0) are. Power-key and mains starts, and later changes, take the vendor path. Generated by tools/patches_src_wake_no_replug.py.
